description: Returns one skill's instructions (its SKILL.md) from wunderui.com, so the agent can follow the workflow without installing the skill. Pro skills are sent only with a valid Pro key in WUNDERUI_LICENSE_KEY. Scripts the skill mentions come with the installed skill (wunderui.com/skills).

name.description: Skill name, e.g. wunderui-theme or wunderui-screen

name: get_skill
title: Get a WunderUI agent skill
